ko.executive_summary: Infineon is expanding hiring in India and Vietnam, while SK하이닉스 has revamped its recruitment process by eliminating essay submissions in favor of half-day intensive interviews. A leading semiconductor manufacturer is opening a design center in Atlanta, signaling geographic diversification.
key_facts: Infineon expanding workforce in India and Vietnam
SK하이닉스 implementing new half-day deep interview recruitment format

implications.text: Infineon's India and Vietnam hiring reflects cost-optimization and talent availability strategies for HPC infrastructure development.
